_doc: The list of 2026-11-11's fifth phase (920 events): 'there should be more different types of events that the player can encounter in the wilderness -- most of the types encountered are the satchels found and ambushers - what else can the player find within a 40s amount of time?'. The encounter director's roaming kinds besides the ambush, the pack and the satchel (poi.json, 912): a point of interest laid ahead of her (place: the kinds of poi.json it picks from, those of her region), a herd of the wild animals (animals), a person on the way who talks (text: lines split by |) and gives the first time she speaks to them (gift: Item|min|max|chance joined by ;, gold: grown with the tier). Weights against the three old ones (0.5, 0.3, 0.4).

kinds.name: roam_find
kinds.title: Something off the path
kinds.text: Something lies off the path ahead

kinds.name: roam_forage
kinds.title: Something to gather
kinds.text: There is something worth gathering ahead

kinds.name: roam_ruin
kinds.title: Ruins
kinds.text: Ruins show through the land ahead

kinds.name: roam_nest
kinds.title: A nest
kinds.text: Something has made its nest ahead

kinds.name: roam_hares
kinds.title: Hares
kinds.text: Hares dart about in the grass ahead

kinds.name: roam_wolves
kinds.title: Wolves
kinds.text: A pack of wolves lopes across your way

kinds.name: roam_pilgrim
kinds.title: a weary pilgrim
kinds.text: Bless you for stopping, traveller. Take this, it is all I can spare.|The shrines on the high roads still answer, they say.

kinds.name: roam_pedlar
kinds.title: a travelling pedlar
kinds.text: Fine goods, cheap! Here, a sample, to remember me by.|I'll be in the next town by nightfall.

kinds.name: roam_hunter
kinds.title: a lost hunter
kinds.text: Which way is the road? I've walked in circles since dawn. Here, some of my catch for your trouble.

kinds.name: roam_courier
kinds.title: a courier
kinds.text: Orders for the garrison, I can't stop! Here, for the road.

kinds.name: roam_refugee
kinds.title: a refugee
kinds.text: They burned our village. If you see my brother on the road, tell him I went to the town.|Take these, I can't carry everything.
